deadline.value: February 15 deadline for international PhD applicants (January 15 priority).
deadline.quote: February 15, 2027: International PhD applicants seeking to begin in August 2027

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no subject test in this discipline.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor contact not specified as mandatory.

funding.value: Fellowships, teaching assistantships, research assistantships (generally 50% with stipend and tuition/service fee waiver), and waivers are available, with PhD applicants given precedence over MS students.
funding.quote: There are several different forms of financial aid available to incoming graduate students: fellowships, teaching assistantships, research assistantships, and tuition and fee waivers. | Please note that PhD applicants have precedence over MS students for teaching assistantships.

entry_route.value: Applicants may apply after completing a master's degree or directly with only a bachelor's degree via direct admission.
entry_route.quote: PhD applicants may apply after having completed (or with the expectation of soon completing) a master’s degree in engineering or a related field, or, via a program called “direct admission,” they may apply having only earned a bachelor’s degree.
